conversation_log.content: Hello, this is Maya calling from Manappuram Finance about a special gold loan offer for existing customers. Do you have a minute?
Actually, before that — I wanted to ask about my existing personal loan EMI date, not the gold loan.
Sure, I can switch to that. Your personal loan EMI is due on the 5th of every month. Would you also like to hear about the gold loan offer, or should I stop there?
Go ahead, tell me about the gold loan too.
Great — the gold loan offer starts at 0.79% interest per month for premium customers like you. Would you like a callback from a branch officer?
